note: Q2 answered with 6 findings. Core result: a click on the alignment does NOT always move focus out of a side window. Full (DOM) mode is a full focus trap: handleNucleotideSelectMouseDown calls e.preventDefault() on every plain left-click on a residue, and handleColumnSelectMouseDown / handleRowSelectMouseDown's Ctrl and Shift branches do too, so with Dot plot / Tree / Group explorer / Statistics open and focused, activeElement never leaves the window and handleKeyDown stays locked out while the user edits the alignment (high/medium defects). In Canvas and Canvas Block, only feature clicks (trim edge, fold marker, annotation, 2D mask, name-drag) call preventDefault and trap focus; the common residue-click and pan branches do not, and since no alignment element has a tabindex (grep: only script.js:29347 slider and a11y.js on dialog nodes), focus moves to body and shortcuts resume (ok). No handler contains an explicit focus()/blur() that compensates. The Group explorer is clusteringModal and is in EXCLUSIVE_MODAL_IDS. Caveat noted in the last finding: quotes for the EXCLUSIVE_MODAL_IDS line could not be verified character-for-character from my noisy reads, so that membership statement carries reduced confidence.
